narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms affected Central Alabama during the afternoon and evening of June 4. One slow-moving thunderstorm over the city of Montgomery dumped 2-3 inches of rain within two hours, resulting in significant street flooding along and south of Interstate 85.
ev: Social media images and videos relayed significant street flooding impeding traffic in Midtown Montgomery, including along Carter Hill Rd near Vaughn Rd, along Aimee Dr, and along Charleton Dr and Ballentine Dr.
lsr: Social media image of street flooding along Charleton Dr and Ballentine Dr.
Significant street flooding reported via social media along Carter Hill Rd near Vaughn Rd and along Aimee Dr.
